answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can transact: the stake is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. Reputation then accrues to one key, not many throwaway accounts, so a sybil operator cannot island-hop between fresh identities for free. Even at the nadir of trust, when a new agent has no history, its locked stake is the proof that creating another identity costs real money, which makes mass forgery unprofitable.
